qs.s: Le médecin a diagnostiqué une ___ rare chez cette patiente.
qs.en: The doctor diagnosed a rare disease in this patient.

qs.s: Certaines ___ infectieuses se transmettent facilement d'une personne à une autre.
qs.en: Some infectious diseases spread easily from one person to another.

qs.s: Il est absent du bureau cette semaine : il est en ___.
qs.en: He is absent from the office this week: he is on sick leave.

qs.s: Son médecin lui a prescrit trois semaines de ___ en raison de son épuisement.
qs.en: His doctor prescribed three weeks of sick leave due to his exhaustion.

qs.s: La corruption est une ___ qui ronge lentement les institutions.
qs.en: Corruption is a social ill that slowly eats away at institutions.

qs.s: L'individualisme excessif est considéré par certains comme une ___ de la société moderne.
qs.en: Excessive individualism is considered by some as a social malaise of modern society.

qs.en: My doctor explained to me that the illness I suffer from requires a long treatment.

qs.en: He contracted a tropical illness during his trip to Africa.

qs.en: He is very competent; besides that, he is always punctual.

qs.s: ___ les frais de transport, vous devrez payer les taxes locales.
qs.en: Besides the transport costs, you will also have to pay local taxes.

qs.s: Ce projet est innovant ; ___, il respecte l'environnement.
qs.en: This project is innovative; furthermore, it respects the environment.

qs.s: Le candidat parle trois langues et possède, ___, une solide expérience internationale.
qs.en: The candidate speaks three languages and, furthermore, has solid international experience.
